source.source_family: Adopted City of York Local Plan 2025 / authority-hosted Local Plan Policies Map
source.identifier_namespace: City of York Local Plan strategic site allocation
source.data_date_basis: City of York Council adopted the Local Plan on 27 February 2025; the authority-hosted adopted Policies Map service is described as April 2025.
source.license: City of York Council public adopted-plan documents and public ArcGIS service; layer-specific reuse licence not stated in the public service metadata.
source.source_geometry_availability: City of York Council's public adopted LocalPlanPoliciesMap exposes Spatial Strategy (areas) layer 4 as esriGeometryPolygon and lists Land North of Haxby; exact ST9 polygon extraction and canonical parcel spatial join are delegated to local OpenCode.
source.source_file_sha256_reason: The official council plan page, plan text and GIS service were accessed through public web transport; raw source-file bytes and the exact ST9 feature geometry payload were not acquired, so no source-file hash or polygon coordinates are fabricated.
